name: The Ridge & Christ Church Shimla
opening_hours: Pedestrian area open 24 hours · Christ Church open 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM
best_time: March to June or December/January for snowfall
rules: Pedestrian-only promenade: vehicular traffic strictly banned
Smoking and littering subject to municipal fines
visual_features: wide open stone-paved ridge promenade anchored by neo-Gothic yellow Christ Church with snow peaks on horizon
description: The Ridge road is a large open space, located in the center of Shimla, the capital city of Himachal Pradesh, India. The Ridge is the hub of all cultural activities of Shimla. It is situated along the Mall Road, the shopping center of Shimla. Most major places of Shimla like Sanjauli Snowdown (IGMC), Mall Road, Jakhu Temple, Oakover, Kali Bari, and Annadale are connected through the Ridge.
